purpose: Evaluate firsthand reviewers of Chinese-manufacturer IPL devices, prioritising CYPH/1's previously investigated IONKA and Semlamp models. Research and competitor validation; not marketing outreach.
caveats: Country of manufacture is not equivalent to common OEM model identity.
FDA clearance of a model family does not establish clearance/compliance or results of another model.
Editorial articles with affiliate links may still contain firsthand use; separate disclosure from claimed independence.
Unknown UK follower geography and commercial partnership feasibility must stay unknown.

firsthandReviewLeads.suitability: Highest priority to investigate as review-methodology expert, not assumed paid influencer or contact approval.
